subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Unit practice 2: Speaking, support and challenge
outcomes: I can answer questions about my body.
I can say body words and movement words.
I can describe a robot with I've got …

tf.s: What's this? (a knee) It's a knee.
tf.why: Yes! The knee is in the middle of the leg.
Great! Five on each hand makes ten.

tf.s: The tummy is on your foot.
tf.why: The tummy is in the middle of your body.

tf.s: Touch your toes means put your hands on your toes.
tf.why: Well done! Bend down and touch your toes.

tf.s: How many legs have you got? I've got four legs.
A robot can say: I've got a blue head.
tf.why: Yes! We use I've got … to describe a robot.
Stretch means make your body long.

tf.s: We say: What's this? to ask about a thing.
tf.why: Great! What's this? asks about one thing.
We have one head: I've got a head.

tf.s: Our knees are on our arms.
tf.why: Our knees are on our legs.

boxes.q: How many hands have you got?
How many arms have you got?
The teacher makes her body long. Say it!
boxes.why: Making your body long is stretch.

boxes.q: Which word is a body word?
boxes.why: The tummy is part of the body.

boxes.q: Touch your ___! (at the end of your feet)
boxes.why: Toes are at the end of our feet.

boxes.q: Describe a robot: I've got ___ arms.
boxes.why: A number tells how many arms.
The colour goes before the body word.

boxes.q: We hit the floor with our feet. We ___.
What do we move to clap?

hunt.q: It's in the middle of your leg.
How many legs have you got?
How many toes have you got?
Hit the floor with your feet.

mcq.q: How many fingers have you got?
Which word is a movement word?
Which question asks about a thing?
mcq.why: What's this? asks about a thing.

mcq.q: The teacher says: Touch your toes. What do you do?
o: Bend and put my hands on my toes
mcq.why: We bend down to touch our toes.

mcq.q: A robot has four arms. What does it say?
mcq.why: Four arms: I've got four arms.

mcq.q: Complete: How many ___ have you got? I've got two legs.
A robot says: I've got a green head and ten red fingers. What colour is its head?
Which answer is NOT right for us?
mcq.why: We have two legs, not three.

mcq.q: Which is the odd one out?
mcq.why: Clap is a movement; the others are body parts.
